notes.purpose: Cheap live smoke of the harness with the default test model only (claude-haiku-5-5). It measures the harness path and the test-retest noise of one model, NOT a savings claim: all arms use the same model.
notes.delta: 0.15 is a smoke value chosen only so that a 15-task run is not trivially underpowered to read; it is not a derived margin.
